assertions.name: asymptotic_shape_matches_derived_expansion
assertions.detail: log<4_1>_N - N*V/(2pi) tracks (3/2)logN - (1/4)log3 with an O(1/N) residual: the residual ratio on each doubling is ['0.492795', '0.496559', '0.498316', '0.499167', '0.499586'], against 1/2 for a clean 1/N tail. The N^{3/2}/3^{1/4} prefactor of the expansion derived in prop:one-loop-prefactor-provenance is therefore reproduced by this corpus's own sum.

assertions.name: N_delta_over_logN_matches_derived_3pi_with_offset
assertions.detail: the DERIVED two-term prediction 3pi - (pi log3)/(2 logN) tracks the measured N*delta/logN to within 0.0183105 across N = 50..1600; at N=1600 the gap is 0.000295239. The offset was derived from the derived expansion before being measured, so this is a test of the derivation, not a fit to the data.

assertions.name: remainder_is_NOT_a_pure_grade_minus_one_monomial
assertions.detail: N*delta_N rises monotonically 35.215883 -> 67.810222 across N = 50..1600, i.e. omega*delta is INFINITE. A grade-(-1) infinitesimal c/omega would give the constant c. So ord_omega(delta) = -1 in the coarse grading, but delta is not a grade-(-1) monomial -- its leading term carries a log omega and sits strictly between grade -1 and grade 0 in the Berarducci-Mantova hierarchy.

assertions.name: richardson_in_one_over_N_leaves_the_derived_residual
assertions.detail: a 1/N Richardson step leaves N*(R_N - V) converging to the DERIVED 3pi*log2 = 6.532758271; measured 6.53057645619 at N=800, gap 0.00218181. So anyone extrapolating the Kashaev limit on a 1/N grid is fitting a mis-specified ansatz -- the leading correction is log(N)/N, not 1/N.

assertions.name: vol41_computed_not_read_from_a_float64_literal
assertions.detail: Vol(4_1) is computed as 2*mp.clsin(2, pi/3) at working precision. The module constant VOL_FIGURE_EIGHT is float64 and would floor every gap in this probe at ~1e-16, which is coarser than check 2's tolerance -- the same trap caught in the N-question probe (8f6771235f).

description: The omega-grade of the Kashaev remainder for 4_1. kashaev-surreal.md recasts the volume conjecture as a standard-part identity and never says what st() discards. Derived from the leading asymptotic that prop:one-loop-prefactor-provenance DERIVES from the saddle at theta*=5pi/6 (Lean c_pow_four_eq_third) -- NOT cited to Ohtsuki/Andersen-Hansen, which is what this description said before the 2026-09-13 correction: expansion: delta_N = 3pi logN/N - (pi log3)/(2N) + O(1/N^2), so ord_omega(delta) = -1 in the coarse grading but delta is NOT a grade-(-1) monomial -- omega*delta is infinite and the convergence is logarithmically slow. Derive-then-check; every constant is read off the citation before measurement. Exact mpmath at 50 dps; no float64.
